question: What scope of understanding is sought regarding the eightfold divisions?
premises: The teaching contains divisions of eight groups of eight
Complete knowledge of these divisions is desired
The desired knowledge is described as endless
inference: The seeker wishes to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight groups of eight
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eight groups of eight is not specified in this verse
plain_english: And to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight groups of eight.
